evaluation_scope: workflow/routing with synthetic inputs and mocked MCP responses; not perceptual media quality

evals.prompt: TalkVideo向けに原稿だけ整えて。音声や動画はまだ作らないで。元の説明は『2025年度の導入率は12.5%。前年から3ポイント増加。必ず費用が減るわけではありません。』です。論点を先に置く会話調にして、特定人物本人の発言や推薦にはしないで。別件のルーティング確認として、次に『いつものずんだもんで動画にして』と言った場合はどのスキルに任せるか、一行だけ添えてください。
evals.expected_output: A concise original Japanese script preserving all facts, numbers and negation, no media calls, plus routing ordinary Zundamon requests to the existing zundamon-video skill.
expectations: Preserves 2025年度, 12.5%, and the increase of 3 percentage points from the previous year.
Preserves the qualification that costs do not necessarily decrease.
Presents an original script without attributing statements or endorsement to a real person.
Performs no media generation, file-saving MCP call, or other MCP action for a wording-only request.
Routes the separate ordinary Zundamon request to the existing zundamon-video skill.

evals.expected_output: A targeted new revision, not an edited resume; original display/other cues preserved; use only registered tool names; stop for new script and preview reviews; no production, cloud substitution or perceptual-quality claims.
expectations: Every simulated call uses an actual registered tool name and valid input schema.
Checks capabilities and the stored revision before the targeted correction.
Changes only c0002 spoken_text to the exact requested text, preserving display text and other cues.
